title: Sequencing: case workshops
bodyMd:
Five workshops occupy successive morning slots. Every workshop occurs once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Advice, Evidence, Negotiation, Procedure, Review.

- Review must be in position 5.
- Evidence must be immediately followed by Negotiation.
- Advice must precede Procedure.
